bge-m3.notes: upgrade path only. Design 0d records no commit SHA, ONNX file layout, file sizes or sha256 for bge-m3, so none are guessed: the revision and files stay empty and the loader refuses this entry. To pin it: download the ONNX export you choose by hand into <dir>/bge-m3/, run `python -m app.scripts.fetch_model bge-m3 --print-hashes --file <path> ...`, review the output, and fill the entry in by hand.
